name: Guided Fire
text: This turn, Gunnbjorn and the warbeasts of his battlegroup have their ranged attack rolls boosted for free while they are inside his CTRL.

name: Rock Wall
text: Raise a straight stone wall completely inside Gunnbjorn's CTRL, clear of bases and terrain. It is an obstacle that gives cover; a large base touching it tears it down.
verify: Duration Up as the data says (older cards: one turn); wall is 4 by 3/4 inch (rulebook wall piece).

name: Sentry
text: A friendly Faction model gains Rapid Fire: it makes one basic ranged attack in your Maintenance Phase.

name: Snipe
text: A friendly Faction model or unit has its ranged weapons reach 3 inches further.

name: Far Strike
text: This turn the caster's ranged weapons reach 3 inches further.
